evidence.title: Cipher Digital Provides First Quarter 2026 Business Update
evidence.excerpt: Cipher reports that the Barber Lake data center building was topped out in April with mechanical, electrical, and networking work ongoing; at Black Pearl, the existing structure's Phase I retrofit was progressing and Phase II layout and site work began in April.

evidence.title: Cipher Digital Inc. 2025 Form 10-K
evidence.excerpt: Cipher's Form 10-K describes the 300 MW gross Barber Lake Facility near Colorado City, allocated as 244 MW Phase I and 56 MW Phase II, and the separate 300 gross MW Black Pearl AWS lease near Wink with retrofit and development commenced in 2025.
